description: List every MCP directory ManyCP can file a server in (26 today). For each one you get: its id (pass ids to submit_server), name and URL, how ManyCP files it (Direct publish, Auto PR, Auto-indexed or Assisted), whether it fits local servers, remote servers or both, whether it must wait for another directory, and what ManyCP does step by step. Read-only, takes no input, works on every plan. Use it to answer 'where can I list my MCP server?' or to pick directory ids for submit_server.
name: list_directories
title: List MCP directories
